Stock market news | Anuh Pharma invests ₹73 crore in 525 tonnes facility, ready by December

Anuh Pharma announced a ₹73 crore investment to build its third bulk drug manufacturing facility in Tarapur, Maharashtra.

The new plant adds 525 tonnes annual capacity, boosting production and supporting demand, and will be fully operational by December, strengthening the pharma supply chain.
